segments.text:
V. 10.
He anſwereth—It is not properly John, but the Holy Ghoſt, who teaches us in the following Anſwers, How to come ourſelves, and how to inſtruct other penitent Sinners to come to Chriſt, that He, may give them Reſt. The Sum of all is, Ceaſe to do evil, learn to do will—Theſe are the fruits worthy of repentance.
